description: Use when an agent must pay for a call to an external AI service (data, search, enrichment, inference, scraping) it has no account with. Finds the service in the Nevermined Agent Services Catalog, prices the call for free, pays per call through the Nevermined Router from a budget a human capped, and checks what was spent.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
